actualTrackingIssueBody:
## Outcome

**Rejected/contract-blocked nonblocking replacement; no shipping change or
performance PR.** This does not reject every future compatible optimization.

The shipped `IHtmlContent Partial(IHtmlHelper,string,object,ViewDataDictionary)`
must return completed content or propagate the renderer's failure. Changing
that exact return signature breaks already-compiled consumers; returning early
changes output, exception and disposal behavior. Existing `PartialAsync` or
PartialTagHelper caller migration is already documented by MVC1000, not a new
framework optimization.

## Evidence

[Immutable evaluation, runnable benchmark project and raw evidence](https://github.com/jaslawinMs/aspnetcore/tree/890fb2aab3127ff1663f4858c77e0b9057d88a16/F029).
The independent [source branch](https://github.com/jaslawinMs/aspnetcore/tree/autoperf/F029-sync-partial-source)
remains at unchanged `37e809ead5824bc753a1c3d56f11615bdb1296c5`.

The probe exercises the real public extension, actual HtmlHelper, real RazorView
and a C# RazorPage whose own pending task controls rendering. It observes the
synchronous caller waiting before release versus the existing async API
returning an incomplete task. Completed output, exact unwrapped failures,
cancellation tokens, cloned ViewData and view disposal are checked. Four
completed wrappers and six pending producer contracts pass in the measured,
byte-exact relocated and formatted runnable images. Existing owning tests pass
34/34, 0 skipped.

One original-only four-case BDN diagnostic retains all32 result samples and
adverse variability (maximum CV33.24%). **Zero source comparisons, no selected
optimization and no gain/API-ranking claim.** The whole wrapper includes scoped
MVC buffer ownership and fixture construction; the pending gates are untimed.
Both historical measurement budgets are permanently closed.

The capsule preserves initial compile/dependency/gate/formatting failures.
Historical measured sources remain byte-exact. The final runnable copy differs
only in recorded whitespace and passes direct formatting, build and producer
characterization, retaining seven analyzer warnings and zero compile errors.
Portable audits pass; omitted native binaries are represented by hashes, not
claimed as publicly rehashed bytes.

Captured current main matches16 selected source/API/producer/analyzer files.
This is a controlled literal Razor producer, not HTTP, cshtml compilation,
application-throughput, starvation or deadlock evidence. The machine is shared.
No priority, affinity, power or unrelated process changes were made for this item.
